establishes: The inventory of call sites that can act on the world, and the recorded role of each. It does NOT establish that any site is enforced at run time: that would need call-graph analysis this build does not perform. A local alias, and a parameter or destructuring default whose right-hand side is a known binding, are followed; dynamic property access (`fs[name](...)`) and a handle that is never locally bound to a known namespace are invisible to it. Nor does any entry here describe what an approved process goes on to do: the guard evaluates the command it is shown, so a process it allowed can write, spawn and transmit without a further decision, and an action refused when requested directly succeeds silently when a permitted process performs it. That boundary decides what "protected" means for this package; it is demonstrated in test/subprocess-boundary.contract.test.js.

unguarded.why: starts the server it supervises and fetches its health URL on a heartbeat. The spawn and health target default to the local server and both are injectable, but neither action passes a gate. The watchdog health-fetch is covered by the bounded exception in ADR-014; the server spawn remains open there

spawns the Rust accelerator at the fixed RUST_BIN path with no arguments. Not agent-controllable, but it is a process launch that no admission decision covers, and RUST_BIN is env-configurable (HUQAN_RUST_BIN). The RUST_BIN resolution hardening and the process-launch gate are the open work in ADR-014

entries.why: the generated custom-agent adapter: its one spawn is the call to the gate itself, made before the agent acts, so gating it would be circular -- it fails closed on a gate it cannot start, parse or recognise
execFileSync of git log to ingest history; argv is fixed and the repository path is the configured workspace
fetches public GitHub data for ingestion; performs no write against the API

the directly invoked bounded causal experiment uses only a checked private mkdtemp directory and removes only that owned scratch path; it exposes no agent action route, opens no canonical memory, and has no network effects

the directly invoked isolated calibration CLI copies DB/WAL into its own mkdtemp directory for read-only authentication and removes only that private scratch directory; it exposes no agent-request route and never writes the supplied database during this check
the A2A delegation audit trail, under the same configured replay directory; one exclusive-create file per exchange, and every write failure is swallowed so recording can never refuse a delegation

the A2A active-delegator cursor beside the replay/task stores, under the host-configured directory; one exclusive-create file per route receipt id, file name is the receipt hash so a cursor cannot escape that directory
the A2A replay reservation store; its durability is what makes at-most-once delivery hold across a restart
the A2A task store backing at-most-once delivery, under the configured replay directory

writes agent memory (goals, runs, tool stats) through a temp file and rename so a run can resume, and moves a corrupt memory file aside; the path is the Agent constructor memoryPath or derived from the kernel graph memoryPath, never a request field

regenerates the deterministic AURA signal pack by running the AURA engine over a temp copy of its case files and writing the artifact next to it; it runs from an operator command (node lib/aura-signal-pack.js), the AURA source tree is never modified, and no agent action reaches the write

reads the live agent-user boundary (ADR-017, #3948): on Windows it trusts the marker path through the install-trust DACL probe, on POSIX through posix-path-trust ownership and mode, then corroborates the marker uids with fixed `getent`/`dscl` and `id -Gn` probes. The commands and paths are fixed in source, it writes nothing, and any step it cannot establish fails closed to the weaker same-user value

the runtime asking the approval authority for a decision is the admission path itself; it connects only to 127.0.0.1 on the port the admin-only pin names and accepts only answers signed by the pinned key, so gating it would be circular

`huqan-authority status` and the doctor's authority finding probe the runtime user's own privilege with a fixed, non-interactive `sudo -n true`; the argv is fixed in source, the probe writes nothing and reads nothing, and it runs only when a human asks for status, so there is no agent action to admit
creates the runtime's consume-proof key once, owner-only, at a fixed path under the user's home; the path is not taken from agent input

re-reads the live owner and DACL of the install directory, the public directory and the pin file through a fixed Get-Acl probe before a parsed pin is trusted; the command and paths are fixed in source, it writes nothing, and a probe that cannot run fails closed to install_path_untrusted

the POSIX counterpart of install-trust.js: it decides whether the installed pin path is root-owned, closed to group and other, and link-free before a parsed pin is trusted, and on darwin runs a fixed `/bin/ls -lde` probe for extended ACLs. Paths are fixed in source, it writes nothing, and a component it cannot inspect fails closed to install_path_untrusted

only `init` writes: it is run once by the operator to create the authority state and the pin (ADR-016 plans for the elevated installer to run it and keep the pin admin-only); `serve` writes nothing itself, and the ledger and state writes it reaches are the service's own store

the approval authority service writes its own keys, TOTP secret and TOTP progress into the state directory named on the service command line, never by an agent; the Windows installer (ADR-016, planned for P5) is to create that directory and ACL it to the service account

the one place the protected store ACL is applied (applyStoreAcl) and read back (checkStoreAcl) for ADR-018 §3. On Windows apply runs icacls only from the elevated `huqan store migrate`, on paths it validates against a fixed drive-letter shape, and check only runs a fixed PowerShell Get-Acl probe. On POSIX apply chowns the root-owned state root and the runtime-owned 0700 workspaces and check reads the same uid and mode bits with lstat; both refuse a path that is not absolute. Neither branch writes anything but the store tree, and no agent input reaches either path

the copy/verify/marker core behind `huqan store migrate` (ADR-018 §2), run only by the operator and only when elevated; it copies the profile store into the protected root it resolves, verifies the copy by sha256 and row counts before writing the marker, and never deletes the profile original. No agent action reaches it
execFileSync of git show to read a file as of a base ref while re-deriving a recorded transform; argv is fixed in source, no shell is involved, and the command only reads history
execFileSync of git rev-parse and git status to report branch and dirtiness to the code-change gate; argv is fixed in source, no shell is involved, and nothing outside the process is mutated

the operator's `huqan mcp` surface (#3999), run only under direct human invocation: enroll/revoke write the protected registry only when elevated, the seed file is written where the operator asked, and the status probe is a fixed loopback POST with an empty unsigned body that exists to observe the refusal

applies a deterministic transform only after ordinary code-change admission or the explicit closed project-initialization permission; initialization uses exclusive creation, and failed writes roll back the files written by this invocation

creates the operator-named journal database directory on explicit coder --journal invocation; mkdir only, the database itself is opened by better-sqlite3 and the journal rows are the gated pilot evidence
explicitly persists candidate-only method bodies in a bounded private coder directory; exclusive creation and fresh sealed-source validation grant no installation or code-write authority
reads live Git identity/status/head to bind a single-use recipe permission; removes only empty src/test directories created by an initialization whose rollback already removed its files

persists bounded candidate-only project ASTs to an explicit external path after native acceptance and sealed verified-source validation; exclusive creation grants no code-write authority and reuse requires fresh project admission and heldouts

native fixed HTTP acceptance for an explicitly authorized memory-backed project revision after ordinary code-change admission; the command-exec gate admits the fixed test command and full generated-output checks surround its execution before sealed retention
mandatory native fixed HTTP verification for explicitly approved closed initialization; its process adapter runs only after the existing command-exec gate admits the fixed command

spawns `ocr review` after a coder write only on explicit human-run coder --verify ocr; argv is fixed in source (shell only on Windows for the npm .cmd shim, with no caller data in the command line), the result is an observed signal that never changes the outcome, and ocr sends the change to the LLM endpoint the operator configured for it

the directly invoked calibration CLI creates only its own private lab directory and exclusive state marker beneath the operator root; existing state is bound to a frozen experiment and locked before its Graph journal is opened, without writing canonical memory

writes the allowed-command list the gate itself reads, atomically and under a cross-process lock, and applies the built-in policy templates (#4102) by backing the replaced file up before writing over it; gating this write through admission would be circular, and the route in front of it requires an operator token the agent API key cannot satisfy

writes the emergency stop records that the identity gate, MCP dispatch, the agent step executor and A2A admission read before acting, and appends the receipt of each stop and lift; gating these writes through admission would be circular. The directory comes from HUQAN_EMERGENCY_STOP_DIR or the state root, never a request field; each record file is named by a hash of its scope and created exclusively, so a stop cannot be overwritten

proves a gate command by running it against a denylisted envelope and writes the adapter that will call it; the spawns are the gate proving itself and the write is the integration it just proved, refused entirely if the sentinel does not block
asks cmd.exe for the 8.3 short name of a gate path with spaces, so the recorded hook command runs in both cmd.exe and PowerShell (#1797); fixed argv, no agent input
writes and removes the gate's own plugin files for the OpenCode, Pi and Hermes profiles, refusing to overwrite or delete anything it did not write
runs a candidate gate command against the synthetic rm -rf / sentinel under each host shell, inside a throwaway directory it creates and removes; the spawns are the gate proving itself
writeJson is the one JSON writer for the gate's own hook and Hermes configuration; every install path writes through it
loads the just-installed artifact (Node runner or the Hermes Python plugin) in a child process and drives the sentinel through it; the spawns are the gate proving itself

removes the gate artifact this install call just wrote when the sentinel refuses it, so a failed install leaves nothing behind; the rest of the installer lives in the external-action-gate-install-*.js modules below

mints the capability card an operator hands to the gate (#2505); the write is refused if the target exists, and there is no agent in the loop -- an agent that could mint its own authority would defeat the card
append-only receipt store; the tenant-scoped JSONL the fleet view reads
the shipped-position cursor beside the receipt trail (mode 0o600, dir 0o700); advancing it past an unshipped receipt would lose evidence, which is why the resync check lives beside it
appends collector counter-seals beside the trail; the cursor writes moved to lib/external-action-receipt-cursor.js with the #2252 split
appends the external-action receipt itself, at the path defaultExternalActionReceiptPath resolves
appends the fitness history series under the resolved state directory; append-only, never rewritten
the GitHub App beta store, at HUQAN_GITHUB_APP_STORE_PATH; written only on the deployment-gated beta path

the streaming trust store file writes, moved here from lib/github-app-streaming-trust-store.js by #2826 without reclassification; at a configured path and only when the streaming-trust flag is enabled
writes the JSON graph snapshot to the configured memoryPath; the non-SQLite backend for the canonical graph
the JSON graph write transaction: writes a temp file beside memoryPath and renames it, so a crash cannot leave a half-written graph
writes HUQAN's own agent registry beside the memory store when the user confirms an agent; never an agent's configuration
stores the Control Room ask/auto approval preference beside the memory store (ADR-019); the path is derived from memoryPath, never from a request
writes an exported package to the caller-named output path
persists learned hypothesis thresholds under the state directory; product-owned data, no external input in the path

the integrity siren reached only from the human-invoked `huqan integrity --notify` command; writes one cursor file beside the ledger (or an operator-named override) recording the last notified seq, and sends nothing itself, so an agent request cannot reach it

runs one bounded MCP stdio exchange with the local `laya-mcp-server` sidecar so plugins/laya-risk.js can ask a calibrated typed question about a candidate action on the synchronous gate seam (#3974). The exchange runs in a short-lived child of this same file (spawnSync of process.execPath, the CHILD_MODE shape scripts/run-test-shard.js already uses) because a synchronous caller cannot flush a Windows pipe write; it performs no write of its own and never decides -- it returns a bounded reading, fails closed when the sidecar is absent, and the spawn target is operator-configured (LAYA_MCP_CMD/LAYA_MCP_ARGS). The call is bounded by an explicit timeout and output cap (LAYA_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS/LAYA_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES) and the sidecar is killed with SIGKILL so a child that ignores SIGTERM cannot block the gate path (#3973)

the durable single-use MCP capability nonce store, reached from mcpServer.js; the directory is resolved from config or beside memoryPath and the file name is a hash of the attacker-influenced nonce, so a nonce cannot escape that directory
records when an MCP client last talked to HUQAN, one small file per client beside the memory store; no tool data

the enrolled-client registry of a protected MCP server (#3999): written only by the elevated `huqan mcp enroll`/`revoke` into the server's protected state directory through a temp-file-plus-rename, at a path the service resolves; never an agent-supplied path

the endpoint pin of a protected MCP server (#3999): written once with the exclusive wx flag by the elevated `service-main init` into the install's public directory; the path is fixed by the installer, and every read is shape-checked fail-closed

the external witness of the approval authority ledger (#3940): it posts only a signed sha256 digest of the ledger head with the anchor public key to the fixed rekor.sigstore.dev endpoint, and reads back entries under that key, accepting only those signed by the Rekor key pinned in source. No ledger content, approval or workspace leaves the machine, and the endpoint is not taken from input

the one place a protected MCP server's ACL is applied and read back (ADR-018 §3, #3999): apply runs icacls only from the elevated installer on fixed-shape paths it validates, and check runs a fixed PowerShell Get-Acl probe that writes nothing. No agent input reaches either path

the per-session stdio proxy is the untrusted side of the envelope boundary (#3999): it carries only signed client envelopes to the loopback endpoint the operator's pin names, refuses a --url that is not 127.0.0.1, reads no protected state, and gating its one fixed egress with the agent gate would be circular the same way gating the authority client would
the durable mutation journal lock; losing it would break replay idempotency

outbound GitHub API calls on the PR Guardian path, which runs as its own deployment and is enabled by operator configuration; no agent action reaches the fetch, so admission has no decision to make here. Recorded as a deliberate, written exception in ADR-014

spawns `ocr review` over the PR base-to-head range on the Guardian path with argv fixed in source (--from/--to/--rule from the snapshot and the base checkout, shell only on Windows for the npm .cmd shim); the change is sent to the operator-configured LLM endpoint and the result is an observed signal that never blocks. No agent action reaches the spawn, so admission has no decision to make here. Recorded as a deliberate, written exception in ADR-014
the quickstart writes a demo workspace on explicit invocation
owns and removes the product-created per-request reasoning sandbox under the OS temp root; the sandbox path is created by HUQAN, never supplied by an agent
writes the allowlist-projected public form of a trust receipt to a caller-named export path
writes the receipt-exporter plugin JSON export to an operator-named path; runs on explicit invocation, not on an agent request
writes the receipt-exporter plugin PDF export to an operator-named path; runs on explicit invocation, not on an agent request
the trust registry record store, under the resolved registry directory
writes and verifies the append-only hash-chained watchdog audit journal at an operator-configured absolute path

starts the server it supervises and fetches its health URL on a heartbeat. The spawn and health target default to the local server and both are injectable, but neither action passes a gate. The watchdog health-fetch is covered by the bounded exception in ADR-014; the server spawn remains open there
central private staging and atomic-replacement primitive for product persistence; callers select the target while this module performs exclusive bounded filesystem writes
writes a simulated source tree for the dogfood run; never reached by an agent request
the human-invoked backup: staging directory rename into place and cleanup of a failed staging directory
the human-invoked restore: atomic file replacement, the progress marker and stale temp cleanup, after a safety backup
the backup store behind the human-invoked backup/restore CLI: directory and file copies, pruning, the manifest, and the SQLite online-backup child process
restore-source validation behind the human-invoked restore CLI; its only spawn is the read-only SQLite integrity check of the candidate file

the registry of store paths this machine keeps, under the resolved state root; the recorded path is a store path the runtime already resolved, never a request field, and every write failure is swallowed so the registry can never refuse an open

fetches public web search results from Brave/Firecrawl/Tavily over pinned https endpoints; sends only the operator query, performs no write against the APIs, and secret/PII queries are blocked by the egress gate before transport
plugin writing its own metric output file; loaded only when an operator enables the plugin directory

spawns the Rust accelerator at the fixed RUST_BIN path with no arguments. Not agent-controllable, but it is a process launch that no admission decision covers, and RUST_BIN is env-configurable (HUQAN_RUST_BIN). The RUST_BIN resolution hardening and the process-launch gate are the open work in ADR-014
spawns process.execPath running __filename in CHILD_MODE -- this is the AB6 isolation mechanism, and its argv is fixed in source
